name: vibe-seller
description: Drive a Vibe Seller server from your agent: create tasks, follow their progress, answer the agent's questions and review plans over the hosted /api/mcp endpoint.

url.title: Vibe Seller server URL
url.description: Base URL of the Vibe Seller server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7777 or https://vibe.example.com. No trailing slash, no /api/mcp suffix.

token.title: API token
token.description: Personal access token, minted in Vibe Seller under Settings -> API tokens. Sent as a Bearer token.
